plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Affiche les réglages de polling, de sync: Shows polling, post-action sync, MQTT and dependency settings. Leave disabled if default settings work for you.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Affiche le polling, le tuning refresh, M: Shows polling, refresh tuning, MQTT and dependencies
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Developer Portal : OAuth manuel via deve: Developer Portal: manual OAuth via developer.cloud.daikineurope.com, 200 req/day quota. Mobile App: Onecta email and password, 3000 req/day quota + real-time WebSocket.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Developer Portal : quota API de 200 requ: Developer Portal: 200 API requests/day quota. OAuth setup required (Client ID / Secret).
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Fréquence de lecture du cloud Daikin en: Daikin cloud read frequency during the day (minutes). Lower = more responsive but uses more API quota. Default: 15 min. Recommended minimum: 5 min (Developer Portal) / 1 min (Mobile App).
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Fréquence de lecture pendant la période: Read frequency during night period (minutes). Default: 30 min. Saves quota when usage is low.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Heure de début de la période nuit (0-23): Night period start hour (0-23). Default: 10 PM. Night polling applies from this hour.
Night period end hour (0-23). Default: 7 AM. Example: 22→7 = night from 10 PM to 7 AM.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Comportement après une commande : mode 1: Behavior after a command: mode 1 = delayed cloud verification (more requests), mode 2 = immediate update without cloud (faster), mode 3 = recommended hybrid (immediate + cloud verification). Default: 3.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Comment déclencher la vérification cloud: How to trigger cloud verification after an action: merge with next polling (saves quota, recommended), dedicated request after delay, or disabled. Default: merge with polling.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Si un refresh post-action est prévu dans: If a post-action refresh is scheduled within the next X minutes, it is merged with the next polling instead of a dedicated GET. Default: 5 min. Reduces quota usage.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Regroupe les commandes MQTT rapprochées: Groups nearby MQTT commands into a single API request (milliseconds). Default: 400 ms. Useful when sending multiple commands in quick succession.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Heure quotidienne (HH:MM) du rafraîchiss: Daily time (HH:MM) for priority consumption statistics refresh. Default: 23:58. Uses 1 reserved API request per day.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Active le mapping automatique des caract: Enables automatic API characteristic mapping for unlisted Daikin models (BRP069A4x, BRP069C4x, etc.). Disable if you encounter unexpected behavior. Default: enabled.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Publie sur MQTT les capteurs en lecture: Publishes read-only sensors on MQTT (outdoor temperatures, diagnostics, etc.). Disabling reduces MQTT noise if unused. Default: enabled.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Ne publie sur MQTT que si la valeur a ch: Only publishes on MQTT if the value changed since last read. Reduces MQTT traffic. Default: enabled.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Port local pour le callback OAuth (mode: Local port for OAuth callback (Developer Portal mode only). Default: 8765. Ensure this port is free and allowed by your firewall.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Préfixe des topics MQTT utilisés par le: MQTT topic prefix used by the daemon (e.g. daikinToMQTT/deviceId). Must match mqtt2 configuration. Default: daikinToMQTT.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Reçoit les mises à jour en temps réel de: Receives real-time updates from Daikin cloud (Mobile App mode). Greatly reduces polling needs. Default: enabled.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Moteur HTTP pour les appels API. Utilise: HTTP engine for API calls. Use curl if Node.js is blocked by Daikin WAF (TLS errors, 403 or repeated timeouts). Default: Node.js.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Branche : installe la dernière version d: Branch: installs latest version of a branch (release-beta recommended). Commit: pinned version by Git hash. For testing or one-off fixes only.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Nom de branche (ex: release-beta, main): Branch name (e.g. release-beta, main) or full commit hash. Supported branches: release-beta and stable V2 versions. Restart dependency installation after change.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Versions du plugin et du daemon à indiqu: Plugin and daemon versions to provide when asking on the Jeedom community.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Si le prochain polling est prévu dans la: If the next polling is scheduled within the defined window (Polling merge window), the post-action refresh waits for that cycle instead of launching a dedicated GET. Reduces API quota usage while ensuring a cloud update.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Lance un GET cloud ciblé sur l'équipemen: Launches a targeted cloud GET on the affected equipment after the refresh delay, regardless of polling schedule. More responsive but consumes an extra API request per action.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Aucune requête GET cloud après une actio: No cloud GET request after an action. Only the local update (according to the chosen refresh mode) is applied. Useful to save quota, but without cloud verification.
plugins/daikinRCCloud/plugin_info/config.Délai en secondes avant le rafraîchissem: Delay in seconds before full cloud refresh after an action. Used in modes 1 and 3. Default: 60 seconds.
